meta.name: genomic-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalise and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches before they corrupt an analysis. Use whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary - converting between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM, WIG, PSL, genePred, Picard interval_list, or region strings; reconciling 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive; left-aligning or trimming indels; checking whether two variant records describe the same change; mapping genomic to transcript, CDS, or protein positions; auditing a BED/GTF/VCF for convention violations; or diagnosing GRCh37 vs hg19 vs GRCh38 vs T2T, chr-prefix, and liftover problems. Triggers include "off by one", "0-based", "1-based", "half-open", "coordinate system", "left-align", "normalize variant", "bcftools norm", "chr prefix", "wrong genome build", "liftover", "REF mismatch", and "HGVS".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在不同坐标约定和基因组版本间转换基因组区间
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理不同工具或基因组版本的坐标数据
copy.tagline_en: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions and genome assemblies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with coordinates from different tools or genome builds

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会转换不同文件格式间的基因组坐标、标准化和比较变异写法、检查参考基因组版本与 contig 命名是否匹配,并审计 BED/GTF/VCF 文件的坐标系错误。
howto.when: 当坐标跨越文件格式、工具或参考基因组版本边界,比如转换坐标体系、左对齐变异、核对基因组版本,或你说出“off by one”“liftover”等说法时触发。

say.text: 把 BED 的 chr1 999-1000 转成 GFF 坐标。
say.note: 会调用转换脚本并告诉你转换方向。

say.text: 用 ref.fa 把 chr1:7:CAC:C 标准化并左对齐。
say.note: 会先核对参考序列再标准化。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude converts genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalises and compares variant representations, checks for assembly or contig-naming mismatches, and audits BED/GTF/VCF files for convention violations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when coordinates cross a format/tool/assembly boundary: coordinate conversion, variant left-alignment, genome-build checks, file audits; or phrases like 'off by one', 'liftover'.

say_en.text: Convert BED chr1 999-1000 to GFF coordinates.
say_en.note: Calls the conversion script and reports direction.

say_en.text: Left-align and normalize chr1:7:CAC:C against ref.fa.
say_en.note: Checks REF against FASTA first, then normalizes.

say_en.text: Check if variants.vcf and annotation.gtf use the same reference genome.
say_en.note: Reports contig naming and length mismatches.
